:::{#thm-taylor-log-one-plus-x}
#### Maclaurin polynomial of $\log(1 + x)$

The Maclaurin polynomial (@def-maclaurin-polynomial) of degree 3 of $f(x) = \log(1 + x)$ is

$$P_3(x) = x - \frac{x^2}{2} + \frac{x^3}{3}$$

:::

::: proof

This is the solution to @exr-miller-taylor-log-one-plus-x, worked in @sol-miller-taylor-log-one-plus-x.

:::
